response.title: Which solar inverter wastes the least power just sitting idle? My cabin only has a small battery bank.
response.answer:
For a cabin with a small battery bank, I'd prioritize low idle consumption over peak inverter efficiency. An inverter that is 95% efficient when running appliances can still waste a surprising amount of electricity just sitting on.

My recommendation is to look for a small pure sine wave inverter with under 5 watts of idle consumption, preferably one with a low-power search or ECO mode.

Why idle consumption matters

Here's how much battery energy an inverter uses just by being switched on, with nothing plugged in:
